overview.title: Service Overview
overview.content: Our Enterprise Cyber Security service provides organisations with advanced, proactive security capabilities. We go beyond fundamentals to deliver penetration testing, security architecture reviews, SIEM implementation, Security Operations Centre (SOC) setup, zero trust architecture design, and cloud security hardening. Our team of certified security professionals works alongside your IT teams to build layered defences, establish continuous monitoring, and ensure rapid incident response capabilities.

features.title: Penetration Testing
features.description: Comprehensive penetration testing across networks, web applications, APIs, and mobile apps to uncover vulnerabilities before attackers do.

features.title: Security Architecture Review
features.description: In-depth review of your security architecture to identify weaknesses, recommend improvements, and ensure defence-in-depth.

features.title: SIEM Implementation
features.description: Full deployment and configuration of Security Information and Event Management systems for centralised threat detection and analysis.

features.title: SOC Setup
features.description: Design and implementation of a Security Operations Centre with 24/7 monitoring capabilities, playbooks, and escalation procedures.

features.title: Zero Trust Architecture
features.description: Design and implementation of zero trust security models ensuring every access request is verified regardless of source.

features.title: Cloud Security
features.description: Comprehensive cloud security assessment and hardening for AWS, Azure, and GCP environments including IAM, network, and data protection.

pricing.title: قیمتیں
pricing.description: Engagements starting from £5,000. Scoped to your enterprise requirements.

steps.title: Threat Modelling
steps.description: We analyse your threat landscape, identify critical assets, and map potential attack vectors specific to your organisation.

steps.title: Security Assessment
steps.description: We conduct thorough penetration testing and architecture reviews to identify vulnerabilities and security gaps.

steps.title: Solution Design
steps.description: We design a comprehensive security solution incorporating SIEM, SOC, zero trust, and cloud security measures.

steps.title: Implementation
steps.description: We deploy and configure all security systems, establish monitoring, and create incident response playbooks.

steps.title: Continuous Monitoring
steps.description: We establish ongoing monitoring, regular testing cycles, and continuous improvement processes to maintain your security posture.
